FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: We answer your questions.
FAQ.q1_question: How old do I need to be to rent?
FAQ.q1_answer: You must be at least 25 years old and have had a valid driver's license for more than 2 years.
FAQ.q2_answer: Yes, all our campers include integrated GPS and Bluetooth connection with your smartphone.
FAQ.q3_answer: We accept small pets with prior notice, for an additional cleaning fee at the end of the rental.
FAQ.q4_question: What happens if there is a breakdown?
FAQ.q4_answer: We have 24/7 roadside assistance. Contact our emergency number and we will handle everything.
FAQ.q5_question: How does the deposit and insurance work?
FAQ.q5_answer: All our campers feature comprehensive insurance with a €1,000 security deposit. The deposit is temporarily held on your card and released after returning the vehicle in perfect condition.
FAQ.q6_answer: Yes. Cancellations more than 30 days in advance receive a 100% refund. (From 29 to 15 days: 50%. Less than 14 days: 0%).

neo.name: NEO
neo.description: NEO is the most versatile camper with superior cargo space. 2,230 liters of garage storage to carry all your adventure gear. Features complete cabin separation for maximum thermal and acoustic insulation, fixed memory foam bed (192x130 cm) plus auxiliary lounge bed, Victron PRO electrical system with 540Ah Lithium, 400W Solar, and 12V Dometic Air Conditioning.

space.name: SPACE
space.description: SPACE redefines camper luxury with a 100% open concept layout (7m² 'The biggest 7m²'). Its electric drop-down roof bed elevates during the day, revealing a panoramic U-shaped lounge with a 360° swivel table for remote work or relaxation. Includes 160L fresh water tank, 540Ah Victron Lithium, 400W Solar, 12V Dometic AC, and Cinema Pack with HD projector.

AboutPage.heroTitle: More than campers. A way to travel.
AboutPage.heroSubtitle: We create spaces to move with freedom and live the journey your own way.
AboutPage.whoText1: Utopia Van Life is born with a clear idea: making camper travel simple, comfortable and truly enjoyable.
AboutPage.whoText2: No complications. No excesses. Only what matters.
AboutPage.whoText3: We design and select each model thinking about how life is lived inside, not just how it looks from the outside.
AboutPage.methodText1: We don't believe in doing more. We believe in doing it better.
AboutPage.methodText2: We take care of every detail of the interior and bet on durable and functional materials. We design spaces meant to be actually used, always looking for the balance between design and practicality.
AboutPage.philosophyText2: It should be simple: start up, move, stop when you feel like it.
AboutPage.philosophyText3: Sleep well. Be comfortable. And enjoy the road.
AboutPage.philosophyText4: That is what we look for with each model.
